extension.summary: Your Vesper recordings and channels on the big screen
extension.description: Watch what Vesper recorded while you were away, resume where you stopped, and record a channel or a programme with one press. Works with a Vesper server on your network, found automatically. Playlists and recordings stay on your server; Kodi just plays them.
extension.disclaimer: Vesper records only the sources you add yourself. Use it for content you have the right to record.
